item.content:encoded:
This letter basically serves as an explanation of how MTF Mu-3 "Highest Bidders" is structured and intended to operate (and is an expanded 'In Foundation-verse' version of SinfulSyntax's original concept pitch at the start of the MTF Contest).

I enjoyed the opportunity to apply my 'multiple branches' headcanon of MTF structuring to a Task Force so well-suited for it.

MAJOR OVERHAUL EDIT: This meeting was my original concept, which I abandoned because I was having a hard time doing it well. DrStranger salvaged the idea and wrote the story out pretty much just as I'd pictured it (Thank you!)
